1. Engagement Scope

The scope of this review was to validate the accuracy and completeness of Society for Environmental Stewardship's EEO-1 Component 2 pay data submission for the 2001 reporting cycle. The assessment involved reconciling source payroll and HRIS data for 210 employees against the final submission file.

2. Methodology

The assessment of Society for Environmental Stewardship's compliance with pay transparency laws included a programmatic scan of 210 of the company's career pages and third-party job boards to verify the presence and accuracy of salary range disclosures.

4. Detailed Findings
CIN-9847-001MEDIUMDEFERRED
Observation

Data subject access requests under GDPR have an average response time of 210 days, exceeding the statutory limit

Corrective Action Required

The 401(k) plan fiduciary committee shall formalize its vendor review process, including the issuance of RFPs and documentation of the selection rationale for all plan service providers.

Management Response

We concur. A project charter has been approved to address this finding. The project manager has been assigned, and a kickoff meeting is scheduled for 2001-01-25.

Owner: HR Business Partner • Due: 2001-04-28
CIN-8252-002LOWIN PROGRESS
Observation

Personal Health Information (PHI) transmitted via unencrypted email for 210 benefits claims

Corrective Action Required

Revise the employee handbook to remove language that could be interpreted as restricting employees' Section 7 rights under the NLRA. Submit revised handbook to labor counsel for review within 60 days.

Management Response

The finding is valid. A budget of $210K has been approved to procure the necessary technology to automate this control. Implementation is projected to take 60 weeks.

Owner: Chief Financial Officer • Due: 2001-02-28
CIN-1545-003MEDIUMOPEN
Observation

§162(m) covered employee list for 2001 is incomplete, omitting 210 former executives

Corrective Action Required

The process for identifying the median employee will be enhanced to include a statistical sampling approach, with the methodology and results documented and presented to the Audit Committee.

Management Response

This finding has been superseded by a subsequent internal audit finding which addresses the same root cause with a more comprehensive corrective action plan. We request this finding be closed and tracked under the new internal audit reference number.

Owner: Director of Public Relations • Due: 2001-05-28
CIN-3177-004LOWOPEN
Observation

Employee handbook contains policies that could be construed as chilling NLRA-protected concerted activity

Corrective Action Required

Recruiting and HR staff will undergo mandatory training on prohibited salary history inquiries, with training completion tracked and certified.

Management Response

The finding is acknowledged. This issue was caused by a temporary system outage on 2001-01-25. The system has been restored, and the backlog of affected transactions has been cleared. We consider this matter closed.

Owner: Director of Corporate Strategy • Due: 2001-05-28
